texts.li: [loan,!late,!lowtech] The comms crackle: {ENEMY}, about the loan. Everything the colony landed with was bought with their money, and the {COUNT} silver it owes them is due. They're very polite about it. They're always polite, right up until they aren't.

[loan,!late,lowtech] A rider of {ENEMY} comes to the gate with a ledger under one arm: the colony's debt of {COUNT} silver is due. The rider is very polite about it. {ENEMY} are always polite, right up until they aren't.
[loan,late,!lowtech] {ENEMY} are back on the comms about the debt, now {COUNT} silver with their interest. They're noticeably less polite this time.
[loan,late,lowtech] The rider of {ENEMY} is back at the gate, ledger and all. With their interest, the colony now owes {COUNT} silver, and the rider has stopped smiling.

[heist,!late,!lowtech] {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} has found the colony. The message is short: {COUNT} silver was taken from {X_objective}, and {X_pronoun} wants every coin of it back. Pay, and {X_pronoun} might call it square. Don't, and {X_pronoun} will come and take it.

[heist,!late,lowtech] A rider in the colours of {ENEMY} brings a message from {X_nameDef}: {COUNT} silver was taken from {X_objective}, and {X_pronoun} wants every coin of it back. Pay, and {X_pronoun} might call it square. Don't, and {X_pronoun} will come and take it.
[heist,late] {X_nameDef} is back for the rest of the money, {COUNT} silver of it now, interest included. The message ends: "I've been patient. Ask anyone. I'm known for it."

li.label: Pay the {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: The silver is handed over, every coin of it. {ENEMY} take it and go, and the colony breathes out for what feels like the first time in weeks.

li.label: Pay half now and ask for more time
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} hands over half the silver and a great many promises. {ENEMY} agree to wait. The rest will cost more when they come back for it.

li.label: Refuse to pay
li.outcome: The answer is no. {ENEMY} won't take it well: they'll come for what they're owed, and they'll keep coming.

li.label: {ENEMY} want their money
li.text: The colony wouldn't pay what it owes {ENEMY}. They've come to take it.
